description: ORGANIZATION IS RECORD SEQUENTIAL (ISO §2023:12.4.5.10.3 GR3) — the written-out RECORD word of the §2023:12.4.5.10.2 {LINE|RECORD} SEQUENTIAL inner choice, introduced 2023 with line sequential; the bare SEQUENTIAL spelling (RECORD is an optional word, §2023:5.2.3) stays legal at every edition
citation: ISO §2023:12.4.5.10.2 (RECORD not underlined — rendered PDF p.357); §2023:9.1.7.2 splits sequential files into record- and line-delimited types
vcr: 2023 introduction — the {LINE|RECORD} inner brace exists only because the Foreword's "Line Sequential file organization" split sequential files in two (§2023:9.1.7.2); before 2023 the format printed a lone SEQUENTIAL; no VCR row
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRS.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmrs" ORGANIZATION IS RECORD SEQUENTIAL.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT F.
    MOVE "A" TO R.
    WRITE R.
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.
